reviews.text:
So happy with the service Yesi and her wonderful team provided! My dog was treated wonderfully and she looks SOOO CUTE !! A little pricey but worth it for the care and professionalism. The grooming totally met our expectations with what we asked for, we got back a happy and fresh baby!
Pictures of before and after for reference
Yesi does a wonderful job with our basset hounds! Our ‘go to’ for regular nail trims.
The answer promptly and inform me that they do not groom cats.

It was my puppy’s first time being groomed. I stopped by to talk to Yesi about my dog prior to the appointment. She was super attentive, kind, and went over the information and what to expect. I was nervous but it’s clear that Yesi deeply cares and that gave me piece of mind. She was patient, attentive, and genuinely excited to take care of Bella. When I saw Bella, she was absolutely stunning! I am so happy with the results and I am definitely going back to Yesi! Thank you for treating my pup with so much love
Amazing service, my dog was so happy and well taken care of.

My dog Bear loves getting groomed here, which is such a relief because he has had anxiety related to being groomed before. The groomer has been very friendly and kind to both me as a customer and Bear which I think helps with his anxiety. Bear also has very sensitive skin because he’s a shih tzu mix and they were willing to use his special shampoo! They do a wonderful job and leave my baby looking great with minimal stress so I highly recommend them to anyone in the area!

Lulu loves to come to Yesi’s!

Yesi is very friendly. She really takes the time to get to know Lulu, especially the first time and even the second time, making sure that they feel comfortable before giving them an amazing grooming and just generally being very caring for our dog.

I had called ahead of time and scheduled an appointment to get my dogs nails trimmed and when I was talking to the receptionist, she had mentioned one dog because it was smaller 10 the other dog would be 15. Today,  when we checked in, we filled out the forms and as soon as we got in the back, another lady asked us do the dogs have fleas. We proceeded to say yes, we’re currently looking for a treatment for them. She proceeded to say that would be an additional $20. Like I stated in the beginning, I had originally called before, why wasn’t this mentioned to me as soon as I was on the phone with you and when I was checking in with you………. why did you wait until my dog went in the back?!?! we understand it contamination /as you mentioned the reason but give us the chance to make an alternative choice not telling us until  my dog get back there paints you as being sneaky, dishonest and moneyhungry! I would advise any owner to ask about the prices and any hidden fees, ultimately I was disappointed with the dishonesty.
Excellent service, I highly recommend them.

Such a great experience with this business! First time ever bringing our pet all I can say is excellent, friendly, and professional service. We were lucky they had availability same day for our dog Boogie. 100% would recommend and come back 👌🏻
Hi, I'm very happy. My dog ​​received excellent treatment, he looked impeccable, and the service was convenient and pleasant. I highly recommend it!

Thank you for your grooming service I loved your work such a professional!!! My doggy came out clean and with a nice cut!! I would recommend to go here 100%!! Bring your puppy’s!! 🫶🏼 Yesi is the sweetest and caring with the dogs I would bring back my dog again!!

Very friendly compared to PetSmart  this is my first time getting my dog groomed I try PetSmart the first time me being a newcomer I didn't know much wasn't treated very kind I saw this one opened up close to me so I checked it out she was very friendly and kind I got  my boy a bath and nail trimming his fur is very soft he looks very clean and he's very happy highly recommended

This was my first time bringing my dogs to a professional groomer in a while, and I couldn’t have asked for a better experience with Yesi. She was incredibly kind, patient, and clearly cares about the animals she works with. After about a year of me grooming my dogs myself, the difference was immediately noticeable—they look amazing and smell so good.
Yesi took great care with the grooming, made me feel comfortable asking questions, and was just genuinely nice to talk to throughout the visit. I could tell my dogs were in good hands, which means everything to me. I’ll absolutely be coming back and highly recommend her services. I have a cattle dog (who sheds A LOT), a poodle mix, and a Yorkie mix. Yesi did a  amazing job on treating my cattle dog  with deshedding. Very much appreciate it 👏 Thank you!!
Really kind and clean space. She’s on time and very respectful! And our dogs look wonderful ❤️

My senior dog Mr.Niño came in today for a bath and brush, which includes Shampoo & conditioner, Blue Berry Facial, blow Dry, 15 Minutes brushing, and Ear cleaning.

Also, a new collar and leash. Happy Boy!  He decided to take the wheel! LOL
Thank you  Yesi for the excellent service. 🩵🫧🐩
#warmwelcomings#loveithere
​"firulais absolutely loved it! The shop was spotless, and the staff were incredibly kind and professional. They did a perfect job grooming him—highly recommend!" Thanks yesi
Yesi’s pet grooming is the best over all of the places I went. The lady there is so sweet and treated my dog like her own while also meeting my dogs needs.

From the warm welcome to the final ta-da! our experience was flawless. The staff are so friendly, professional, and clearly love animals. They listened to exactly what we wanted and delivered. Our dog, Bella, usually hates baths, but she was wagging her tail the whole time! We'll be back for sure!
Thanks Yesi’s Pet Grooming!
